thresholds: All unique pooled inner decision-function scores, plus 0 and nextafter(max_score,+inf). Predict High when score >= threshold. Scores are uncalibrated margins, not probabilities.
selection: Jointly choose C, gamma, High weight and threshold from pooled inner predictions. F2 rule maximizes F2, precision, recall, threshold, then earlier candidate. Guard requires current RF recorded inner recall, minimizes FP, then maximizes recall, precision, F2, threshold, then earlier candidate. Inner guard is not an outer guarantee.
validation: Original five stratified outer folds repeated with five original seeds, four stratified inner folds. One-hot encoding and scaling fit separately on each real inner training group. No augmentation or new inputs. Original RF reference predictions copied unchanged. Complete procedures evaluated only on excluded real students.
interpretation: Target primary BAT score >=4, 17 High and 80 Below-high. Small B eight inputs only. Exploratory after repeated experiments on these 97 students, not independent or clinical validation. No probability calibration or deployment fit.
